reply_text:
I told Dana in a reply to her #north-team message that the 2026 renewal figure for Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261 seats. Ilse posted it in that channel on Oct 14.

I also pointed out that the 185 seats earlier in the channel came from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025, corrected from 180, and isn't the 2026 renewal. Dana could already see everything I used, since it's all in #north-team. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it didn't need approval.
